subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers rebase/adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454 against the current transcript split, or close it and ask for a new narrow replacement?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and security-sensitive, but an open conflicting PR already owns the fix path, so starting a parallel automated fix would create competing branches.

options.title: Rebase or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Bring the existing candidate fix onto current main, adjust it to the transcript split, and require focused regression proof before merge.

options.title: Request a fresh narrow PR
options.body: Close or supersede the stale conflicting branch and ask for a replacement that only fixes transcript header cwd isolation.

options.title: Defer with issue open
options.body: Keep the report open without branch work if maintainers want to handle the broader process.cwd isolation cleanup first.

recommendation.title: Rebase or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Bring the existing candidate fix onto current main, adjust it to the transcript split, and require focused regression proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main transcript split is blamed to his recent commit, so he is the best available routing owner for choosing the repair path.
